findings.quote: Subtracting the velocity at t = 8 s from the velocity at t = 5 s instead of integrating gives 369 cm instead of 1287 cm.
findings.note: The order of subtraction is reversed: subtracting v(8) from v(5) gives 258 - 627 = -369, not +369. The error described is real (taking the velocity change instead of the integral) but the wording names the wrong difference.
findings.fix: Subtracting the velocity at t = 5 s from the velocity at t = 8 s instead of integrating gives 369 cm instead of 1287 cm.
